name: Pudge the Blunderer
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 37 HP, Pudge's damage increases to 1d12+2.
lastStand: Pudge is dying! 20 more damage and he dies. Until then, Pudge can move 6 spaces, and use Grab & Throw each turn.

actions.name: Move & Smack
actions.description: 1d8+2. Move 8. On damage: Prone.

actions.name: Grab & Throw
actions.description: 1d8+2. On damage: they are thrown at another hero within 6 spaces. Both make a DC 12 DEX save or take 1d8+2 damage and are knocked Prone, half damage on save.

name: Kelebek & Poppy
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose Kelebek OR Poppy to act.
bloodied: When Kelebek is reduced to **30 HP**, Poppy always Interposes for him.
lastStand: When Poppy dies, the room is filled with noxious gas: all heroes have a maximum of 2 actions each turn.

actions.name: Vinelash
actions.description: Move 6, then 2d6. On damage: move target to an unoccupied space within 10 spaces.

specialAbilities.name: Stink Cloud
specialAbilities.description: When damaged, enemies within 2 spaces make a STR save (DC equal to the higher of 10 or the damage done). On a failure, they must spend their next action vomiting, and they cannot take reactions this round.

actions.name: Crushing Mandibles
actions.description: Move 6. 4d6 damage, up to 2 adjacent creatures.

name: Grimbeak, the Unyielding
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
lastStand: Grimbeak is dying! 30 more damage and she dies. Until then, her Attacks use d10s instead of d6s.

specialAbilities.name: Brutal
specialAbilities.description: Treat the highest die rolled as the Primary Die. On crit: knock Prone.

actions.name: Savage Screech
actions.description: 2d6. All enemies within reach 12 suffer damage (ignoring armor). DC 11 WIL save or become Frightened for 1 round.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: 2d6. Move 8.

name: Thorn Quickblade
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: Smoke Bomb. At 62 HP, Thorn immediately becomes invisible (until the end of his next turn), then moves 8, ignoring opportunity attacks.
lastStand: Mortal Panic! Thorn is dying! 30 more damage and he's dead! Until then he'll Strike Back EVERY time he's hit (1/turn).

specialAbilities.name: Strike Back
specialAbilities.description: When crit, make a Heart Piercer or Stormquill attack in return.

actions.name: Stormquill (Crossbow)
actions.description: 4d4+10 (Range 8). Move 4.

actions.name: Heart Piercer (Rapier)
actions.description: 2d4+3. Move 8. On crit: Dazed.

name: Ravager of the Lowlands
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 65 HP, his Venomous Stinger recharges.
lastStand: The Ravager is dying! 40 more damage and he dies. Until then, the first time each turn he takes damage, he uses Move & Claw.

specialAbilities.name: Feral Instinct
specialAbilities.description: Whenever Ravager is crit, he can fly 10.

actions.name: Venomous Stinger
actions.description: 5d12. Reach 3.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: 1d12+6. Fly 10.

name: Nalzar, Apex Predator
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 90 HP, her Wing Buffet Range and DC increase by 2.
lastStand: Nalzar is dying! 60 more damage and she dies. Until then, each turn, she moves 6, then uses Devour (ignoring the Prone requirement).

specialAbilities.name: Tail Swipe
specialAbilities.description: When dealt slashing or lightning damage: knock a hero within 3 spaces Prone.

specialAbilities.name: Torn Wings
specialAbilities.description: Each slashing crit reduces the Wing Buffet DC by 1.

actions.name: Devour
actions.description: 4d12+6 (Prone creatures only, Reach 2)

actions.name: Wing Buffet
actions.description: 1d12. Fly 8, then land. Cone 8: then DC 14 STR save or also knocked Prone (advantage if behind cover or another hero).

name: Queen Aranya, Broodmother
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: "Avenge Your Queen, My Brood!" At 80 HP, summon 3 spiderling minions/hero anywhere within Reach 8.
lastStand: Aranya is dying! 40 more damage and she dies. Until then, Hatch Brood after each of her turns.

specialAbilities.name: Weave Web
specialAbilities.description: Creatures she hits are entangled in a sticky web (Dazed).

specialAbilities.name: Flammable Webs
specialAbilities.description: Fire critical hits suppress the Broodmother's Weave Web for 1 turn.

actions.name: Impale
actions.description: 2d8+8 (Reach 2) Then skitter away up to 8 spaces.

actions.name: Hatch Brood
actions.description: Summon spiderling minions (1/hero, size: d8); they act only when commanded.

actions.name: Dinner Time!
actions.description: Command all of your spiderling minions to move up to 6 spaces and attack once each.

name: Florindris, Bane of the Forest
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 100 HP, enemies within Reach 12 gain Thornblight, and Petal Storm recharges.
lastStand: Florindris is dying! 70 more damage and she dies. Until then, Aura of Wind and Gust move creatures twice as far.

specialAbilities.name: Aura of Wind
specialAbilities.description: Ranged attacks against you have disadvantage. End of turn: push adjacent creatures 2 spaces away.

specialAbilities.name: Wither
specialAbilities.description: Resistant to necrotic damage, but it suppresses Aura of Wind for 1 turn.

actions.name: Petal Storm
actions.description: 3d10+10. Damage to all enemies within Reach 8, half on a DC 13 DEX save.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: 1d10+10. Fly 10 before or after attacking. (Reach 2) Up to 2 targets within reach. On hit: Gain Thornblight (suffer 5 damage for each space forcibly moved, magical healing ends).

actions.name: Gust
actions.description: (Reach 8) Move a target 1d10 spaces.

name: General Flameheart
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 87 HP, on his next turn, he uses Molten Fury a number of times equal to half the number of heroes (rounded up).
lastStand: Flameheart is dying! 80 more damage and he dies. Until then, the area of his attacks increase to a 3×3 square.

specialAbilities.name: Cinder Armor
specialAbilities.description: Immune to fire. When damaged, deal 5 fire damage to all adjacent creatures.

specialAbilities.name: Extinguish Flame
specialAbilities.description: Cold or radiant crits extinguish all areas ignited by Molten Fury and suppress Cinder Armor for 1 turn.

actions.name: Inferno Cleave
actions.description: 2d10+10. Move 8 then strike a 2×2 square area for fire damage.

actions.name: Molten Fury
actions.description: 2d10+10. Lob a molten fireball at the furthest hero not already in the flames, igniting a 2×2 square area. Another 10 damage at the end of each of their turns if they remain in the area.

name: Vael, Undying Necromancer
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, Bane attacks for 1d12+6 then Vael chooses one:
bloodied: At 125 HP, Vael gains the reaction Shield of Cruelty. (1 time use) If Vael would be damaged, instead he may reflect that much radiant damage back at the attacker.
lastStand: DEATH, AN OLD FRIEND. Vael is dying! 90 more damage and he dies. Until then, he gains Heavy Armor, the hero that most recently damaged him is reduced to 0 HP, and Bane is sacrificed into a Vengeful Spirit. It deals 1d12+6 necrotic damage to creatures within reach 3 at the end of each of his turns.

specialAbilities.name: Protect Master!
specialAbilities.description: Whenever Vael would fail a save or take 20 or more damage, he may sacrifice his Lifebinding Spirit, Bane, instead. He spends his next turn moving up to 6 spaces and summoning Bane.

actions.name: DOOM
actions.description: 5d12 (Range 12) (Undamaged target) DC 14 WIL save or full damage. Half on save.

actions.name: Veilwalker's Rebuke
actions.description: 2d12+6 (Range 8). Double damage against those behind cover. 1/round you may swap places with them.

actions.name: Cruelty's Edge
actions.description: 1d4+2. On hit: DC 14 WIL save or Dazed and Frightened. Then move 6.

name: Titan of the Deep Woods
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
lastStand: Shattered Legion. At 0 HP Titan collapses into 4 skeleton minions/hero (d10 sized). If any remain, they reassemble into the Titan the next evening.

specialAbilities.name: Splintering Legions
specialAbilities.description: Bludgeoning damage or any crit cause bones to splinter off and animate, forming a d10 minion.

specialAbilities.name: Brittle Bones
specialAbilities.description: Resistant to piercing, vulnerable to bludgeoning.

actions.name: Devastating Strike
actions.description: 1d4+30 (Reach 4) On hit: Knockback 6.

actions.name: Crushing Stomp
actions.description: 1d4+20. Move up to 10 spaces. Up to 2 targets along the path. On hit: Prone.

actions.name: Beckoning Doom
actions.description: The 2 furthest heroes make a DC 16 STR save or are moved adjacent to Titan.

name: Ul'vek, Psionic Despot
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 150 HP gain Illusory Shift. Reaction, when attacked (1 use): Swap places with a Dominated creature, making them the new target of the attack.
lastStand: Ul' is dying! 110 more damage and he dies. Until then, Dominated no longer ends on taking damage. Every hero makes a WIL save or become Dominated.

specialAbilities.name: Mind Shield
specialAbilities.description: Whenever Ul' would fail a save or take more than 30 damage while he has a creature Dominated, he may avoid the attack instead, but all Dominated creatures come to their senses.

actions.name: Dominate
actions.description: 2d12 (If no creatures are Dominated) Choose half of the heroes to suffer psychic damage (ignoring armor). DC 15 WIL save or Dominated as well. Dominated: Rolls are made with disadvantage. Ul' spends your first action on each of your turns. Damage ends.

actions.name: Consume
actions.description: 6d12 (Dominated creature) Contested DEX or STR check, on success: Grappled. Cannot be Defended or Interposed against.

actions.name: Control
actions.description: Teleport 8. (Reach 8) DC 15 WIL save, force an enemy to spend one Action to make a weapon attack or cast a cantrip. On save, they attack with disadvantage.

name: Dravok, All-Seeing Tyrant
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, Move 6 and then either use Eye Ray OR Terrible Maw:
bloodied: To Dust! At 110 HP, use Petrification Ray against every enemy. His save DC increases to 18.
lastStand: Dravok is dying! 70 more damage and he dies. Until then, each turn he will move or use Warping Ray and then Devastation Beam: 2d12+20 in a 10 space long, 2 space wide line.

specialAbilities.name: My plans, flawless!
specialAbilities.description: Dravok makes all saves with +1 Advantage, attacks against him have Disadvantage.

specialAbilities.name: Weakness
specialAbilities.description: Taking more than 12 piercing or slashing damage: Dravok's plans are FLAWED! (until the end of the next hero's turn.)

actions.name: Eye Ray
actions.description: (Range 10) Randomly chosen ray then choose target: 1. Warping Ray: 3d6, On hit: Dazed, exchange places. 2. Petrification Ray: Permanently Dazed, healing ends (3 stacks = Petrified). 3. Terror Ray: 5d10 psychic & Terrified. 4. Gravitation Ray: 2d6, push that many spaces, Prone on 7+. 5. Charm Ray: DC 16 WIL or spend 3 Actions controlled. 6. Death Ray: DC 16 STR or drop to 0 HP.

actions.name: Terrible Maw
actions.description: 4d4. Melee attack. EVERY die can crit and is Vicious.

name: Azriel, Lord of Pain & Flame
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 160 HP, Azriel can use Crackling Whip twice each turn.
lastStand: YES, MORE PAIN! Azriel is dying! 180 more damage and he dies. Until then, EVERY hit against him is a crit.

specialAbilities.name: PAIN!
specialAbilities.description: Crits against Azriel are Vicious, he deals damage equal to the crit dice back to the attacker.

actions.name: Crackling Whip
actions.description: 3d12. Move 6. (Reach 6) On hit: Grappled and pulled adjacent to Azriel (escape DC 17 STR, DEX, or until he uses the whip again).

actions.name: Doom Sword
actions.description: 3d12+10. Fire damage to all creatures within Reach 2.

name: Gloomwing the Cruel
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:
bloodied: At 160 HP Gloomwing's Rot Breath recharges.
lastStand: Gloomwing is dying! 150 more damage and he dies. Until then, the damage and range of His Aura of Rot is doubled.

specialAbilities.name: Aura of Rot
specialAbilities.description: Creatures within 6 spaces take 5 necrotic damage at the end of their turns.

specialAbilities.name: Light Sensitivity
specialAbilities.description: Radiant damage suppresses Aura of Rot until the end of the next hero's turn.

actions.name: Rot Breath
actions.description: 8d10. Fly 10, then (Cone 8) DC 17 DEX save or necrotic damage, half on save.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: 3d10 (Reach 2) Move 6. On damage: Cruelty's Gift (Healing is halved and Vulnerable to necrotic, healing ends).

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: 3d10+10 (Reach 2) Slashing + necrotic damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: 1d10 (Reach 4) Knocked back that many spaces.

name: Alaric Draegoth, the Crimson Count
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, summon 1 blood bat minion (d10) within 8 spaces, then choose 1:
bloodied: At 160 HP, gain Mistform. Not vulnerable to radiant. Bat Decoy: Whenever Alaric would take damage, instead first swap places with a bat minion, 1/round.
lastStand: Alaric is dying! 160 more damage and he dies. Until then, his Sanguine Cloak, attacks, and bats roll d20s instead of d10s.

specialAbilities.name: Sanguine Cloak
specialAbilities.description: (1/turn) Deal 1d10 necrotic damage whenever you are hit, the attack is reduced by this amount.

specialAbilities.name: Sunscorn
specialAbilities.description: Vulnerable to radiant. After taking radiant damage, use Beguile as a Reaction, they roll with disadvantage.

actions.name: Ebonfang
actions.description: 1d10+15. Your target is considered Bloodied for 1 round. Fly 8 before or after attacking.

actions.name: Beguile
actions.description: If no creature is Beguiled, Beguile a target on a failed DC 18 WIL save (w/ disadvantage if Bloodied). Beguiled: Dazed. Cannot Defend or allow anyone to Interpose for you. Damage ends.

actions.name: Beckon & Bite
actions.description: 2d10+30. Move a Beguiled creature adjacent to you and bite them. Also deals 1 Wound.

name: Caerys, the Hollow Star
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose 1 not yet chosen (reset when all have been chosen):
bloodied: At 310 HP, Gravitational Mastery: Move ALL objects and creatures within 16 spaces anywhere else within the area. Gravitational Lensing: The hero with the most HP is marked by Caerys. She takes half damage from all sources, her mark takes the other half. This lasts until the mark drops to 0 HP.
lastStand: Use Gravitational Mastery, then Caerys is dying! 200 more damage and she dies. Until then she chooses twice each turn. If still alive after 1 round: Reset Time: she resets back to full HP.

specialAbilities.name: Ravages of Time
specialAbilities.description: At the beginning of each round, all heroes suffer 1 Wound.

specialAbilities.name: Slipstream
specialAbilities.description: 3/encounter when she would suffer any negative effect she can swap places with a creature of her choice making them the target instead. All heroes recover 1 Wound.

actions.name: Wormhole
actions.description: 3d20. Teleport 12. Damage to a creature adjacent to where you began or ended.

actions.name: Immensity
actions.description: 3d20 (Reach 12) DC 20 STR save (disadvantage if within Reach 4) or damage and Prone. Half on save.

actions.name: Glimpse Your End
actions.description: DC 20 WIL save or DOOMED: Concentration ends, the next damage roll against you is maximized.

actions.name: Plasma Storm
actions.description: 2d20+2d20. Reach 6, DC 20 DEX save or lightning and fire damage. Half on save.

actions.name: Singularity
actions.description: 5d20. Reach 2, bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Almighty Push & Pull
actions.description: (Range 12) DC 20 STR save or be launched 20 ft. into the air, repeat until the target saves. Fall damage for this attack is 1d20 for every 10 ft. fallen.
